# Security policy

Report a security vulnerability in C3 Code privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/CoreCodeAI/c3code/security/advisories/new). Do not
open a public issue, and do not disclose it publicly until we have had a reasonable chance to
investigate and fix it.

C3 Code is an unofficial fork of T3 Code and is not affiliated with T3 Tools, Inc. A problem that
also affects [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) itself should be reported to T3 Tools
under their own security policy. Problems in T3-operated services, such as T3 Connect's hosted
relay or `app.t3.codes`, are theirs, not ours.

We support the latest release and `main`.
